node.title: Rational-normal kernel curve at the strict endpoint
node.statement: At the official first strict A=3,e=m endpoint, the (4m+1) by 4m Hankel pencil has generic rank 4m-1 and exactly one right singular block. The two-sided minimal-index theorem identifies it as L_m. Consequently, if Q(U,V;X)=sum_j Q_j(X)U^(m-j)V^j is the full primitive kernel generator, its m+1 coefficient forms Q_j are linearly independent. The separation rank of Q is exactly m+1, and the projective kernel map is a degree-m rational normal curve. Domain evaluation is injective. At least 3m+2 supported points of the curve are squarefree D-split locators, and at least 15m domain-evaluation hyperplanes each cut it in m distinct supported points. This exposes the exact endpoint geometry but does not exclude it.
